title.narrative: EU GREEN: EU Support for Growth trough Egyptian Environment Networks

description.narrative: The project aims to improve the quality of life fro the Egyptian population through enhanced environmental performance and climate change mitigation, adaptation and mainstreaming in development sectors. To do so, the project will increase the capacity of the Ministry of Environment and its affiliated entities and will increase the participation and economic opportunities of NGOs and Green Entrepreneurs.
